description: This file defines a Java class 'AdminAccessDeniedHandler' that implements the Spring Security 'AccessDeniedHandler' interface. It handles access denial by redirecting users to a specific URL when they lack permission to access certain resources.

classes.name: AdminAccessDeniedHandler
classes.description: A handler for managing access denied scenarios in an admin context, redirecting unauthorized users to a predefined URL.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle access denied exceptions by redirecting the user.
